subject: Drawing a shape around a data region region

messages.author: f6aff3ab0165e685
messages.subject: Drawing a shape around a data region region
parts:
Hi, 

Wanted to know if there is a way to have ggplot draw a line around an irregular data region. Frequently published figures will have a circle or a square drawn around a region of data to categorize it. 
1. Is there a way of doing this.
2. I can't see to trick geom_density2d or geom_contour into doing it.

library(ggplot2)
#creates a dataframe with 2 distinct data clusters with different shapes
data<-data.frame(x=(rbinom(1000, 1, 0.5)+0.1)*rnorm(1000, 100,50), y=rnorm(1000, 100, 50))

x11()
p<-ggplot(data=data, aes(x,y))
p+geom_point()+
#ideally would draw a single shape around all or 
#95% of the data, does not currently do this. 
# Problem is that multiple lines are being drawn.
  geom_density2d(data=data[data$x<35,])+ 
  geom_density2d(data=data[data$x>35,])

x11()
#z was added to create some random z data so the
# function would accept the xy data.   
p<-ggplot(data=data, aes(x,y, z=runif(length(x), 1, 2))) 
p+geom_point()+
#binwidth set to one so all of the data is lumped into 
#1 bin and a single circle is drawn. Does not work.
  stat_contour(data=data[data$x<35,], binwidth=1)+ 
  stat_contour(data=data[data$x>35,], binwidth=1)

messages.author: f6aff3ab0165e685
messages.subject: Re: Drawing a shape around a data region region
parts:
Well, it seems convex hulls are the "solution" most people are going with.  Is there a simple way to spline the convex hull.  

#Working solution:

library(ggplot2)
find_hull <- function(df) df[chull(df$x, df$y), ] #stumbled across on stackoverflow

geom_polygon(data=find_hull(data[data$x<35,]), fill=NA, colour="black", size=1)+
  geom_polygon(data=find_hull(data[data$x>35,]), fill=NA, colour="red", size=1)

#other option no real difference in the solution other than not having to fiddle with "fill" settings. 
a<-find_hull(data[data$x<35,])
b<-find_hull(data[data$x>35,])
a1<-rbind(a,a[1,])
b1<-rbind(b,b[1,])

- use alphahull for more general contours

On 26 July 2013 14:03, Thomas <thoma...@maine.edu> wrote:

Well, it seems convex hulls are the "solution" most people are going with.  Is there a simple way to spline the convex hull.  

#Working solution:

library(ggplot2)
data<-data.frame(x=(rbinom(1000, 1, 0.5)+0.1)*rnorm(1000, 100,50), y=rnorm(1000, 100, 50))

find_hull <- function(df) df[chull(df$x, df$y), ] #stumbled across on stackoverflow

x11()
p<-ggplot(data=data, aes(x,y))
p+geom_point()+
  geom_polygon(data=find_hull(data[data$x<35,]), fill=NA, colour="black", size=1)+
  geom_polygon(data=find_hull(data[data$x>35,]), fill=NA, colour="red", size=1)

#other option no real difference in the solution other than not having to fiddle with "fill" settings. 
a<-find_hull(data[data$x<35,])
b<-find_hull(data[data$x>35,])
a1<-rbind(a,a[1,])
b1<-rbind(b,b[1,])

x11()
p<-ggplot(data=data, aes(x,y))
p+geom_point()+
  geom_path(data=a1)+
  geom_path(data=b1)
